subject: Next steps: Cloudline partnership — marketplace & GSI technical deep dive

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & proposed next steps after today's discovery

Hi Anita — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before scheduling the next session:

- Primary use case: Cloudline will embed Redwood-hosted inference behind a managed offering for enterprise customers (secure private endpoints + marketplace listing).
- Expected initial volume: ~200k tokens/day (pilot), expected ramp to ~2M tokens/day within 6 months if pilot succeeds.
- Models considered: Llama-2 / mix of open/quantized variants for latency/cost tradeoffs.
- Compliance: SOC2 required; possible customer requests for VPC/private deployment and KMS integration.
- Success criteria: <150ms p95 for short text generation (<=256 tokens), deterministic cost projection for marketplace SKU, and checklist for marketplace listing readiness.

Next step I propose: a technical deep dive + marketplace onboarding sync where we can bring in our solutions engineering (Marcus) and Redwood marketplace ops (Vanessa) to cover: architecture options, deployment variants (hosted vs private), sample latency/cost numbers, and marketplace listing requirements/contract flow.

Proposed 60–75 minute slots (all next week) — please confirm which works in your timezone or suggest alternatives:
- Tue, Jun 29 — 10:00 AM PDT / 1:00 PM EDT / 19:00 CEST
- Wed, Jun 30 — 10:00 AM PDT / 1:00 PM EDT / 19:00 CEST
- Wed, Jun 30 — 4:00 PM PDT / 7:00 PM EDT / 01:00 CEST (Thu)

I attached our discovery notes and a draft agenda (see attachments). If you can confirm preferred slot and any additional attendees (e.g., your infra or procurement leads), I’ll circulate a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the momentum.

— Karthik
